message: "Event": @index field arguments such as sort or length are not supported; Prisma 8 indexes carry none.

Field "Document.data": @default("null") is the JSON value null, which the contract cannot tell apart from SQL NULL. Remove the @default or give it another JSON value; either changes the column default on Prisma 7's next migration.

Relation field "Pet.owner": onDelete: SetNull sets the foreign key fields to null, but "Pet.ownerId" is required, so Prisma 8 cannot describe this foreign key. Make "Pet.ownerId" and "Pet.owner" optional, which drops NOT NULL on Prisma 7's next migration and makes them nullable in the Prisma 7 client, or choose another action, which replaces the foreign key on Prisma 7's next migration and leaves the Prisma 7 client unchanged.
